cybelangel_platform_raw.dataset_description: CybelAngel is an external attack surface management platform that detects exposed assets, leaked credentials and malicious domains.

id.field_description: The identifier of the CybelAngel report or report comment.

report_content.field_description: The full content of the CybelAngel report, in Markdown format.

abstract.field_description: A short summary of the findings in the CybelAngel report.

category.field_description: The threat category CybelAngel assigns to the report.

incident_id.field_description: The identifier of the CybelAngel incident the report is associated with.

ip.field_description: The IP addresses of the exposed asset related to the report, separated by semicolons.

liveness.field_description: The reachability state of the exposed asset.

machine_name.field_description: The name of the machine associated with the CybelAngel report.

malware_location.field_description: The location of the malware on the infected machine.

malware_name.field_description: The name of the malware associated with the leaked credentials.

port.field_description: The target port of the exposed asset reported by CybelAngel.

report_type.field_description: The type of report CybelAngel generated for the detected exposure.

risks.field_description: The risks CybelAngel identified for the report.

severity.field_description: The numeric severity level of the CybelAngel report.

threat.field_description: The asset or domain identified as the threat in the CybelAngel report.

title.field_description: The name of the threat reported in the CybelAngel report.

city.field_description: The city where the exposed asset in the CybelAngel report is located.

location.field_description: The geographic location of the exposed asset in the CybelAngel report.

hostnames.field_description: The list of hostnames associated with the exposed asset in the CybelAngel report.

tags.field_description: The list of tags attached to the CybelAngel report.

asset_urls.field_description: The list of URLs of the assets affected by the CybelAngel report.

report_id.field_description: The identifier of the CybelAngel report being mirrored.

domain.field_description: The domain monitored in the domain watchlist or associated with the leaked credential.

status.field_description: The current status of the CybelAngel report, watched domain, or leaked credential.

registrant_name.field_description: The name of the registrant of the monitored domain, from WHOIS data.

registrant_organisation.field_description: The organization that registered the monitored domain, from WHOIS data.

mx.field_description: The mail exchange (MX) records of the monitored domain.

ns.field_description: The name server (NS) records of the monitored domain.

abuse_email.field_description: The abuse contact email address related to the reported asset.

country.field_description: The country associated with the monitored domain.

ip_address.field_description: The IP address associated with the leaked credential.

alert_ids.field_description: The list of CybelAngel alert IDs related to the leaked credential.

email.field_description: The email address of the credential found leaked in the credential watchlist.

user_machine_name.field_description: The host name of the machine where the leaked credential was found.

user_session.field_description: The session identifier of the user associated with the leaked credential.

SOURCE_LOG_TYPE.field_description: The event type of the CybelAngel record.
